---
title: "Timeline"
subtitle: "The statutes and Supreme Court decisions in the order they came, grouped by era."
toc: true
---

```{r}
source("R/helpers.R")
statutes <- load_statutes()
cases    <- load_cases()
```

Each generation of national security law answered the problems of the one before. Read an era's entries together to see the pattern: a crisis, a grant of power, and later a constraint, often prompted by a court decision. Dates are years of enactment or decision; for code-title and annual-series entries they are the year the title or series began. Court cases are shaded.

```{r}
#| results: asis
items <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  statutes |> dplyr::transmute(
    id, year, era, kind = "statute", domain, name = title,
    badges = paste0("<span class=\"status status-", status, "\">", status_label, "</span> ",
                    "<span class=\"layer-badge\">", layer_label, "</span>"),
    href = paste0("../statutes/", id, ".html"),
    text = plain_wiki(first_sentence(summary), statutes)
  ),
  cases |> dplyr::transmute(
    id, year, era, kind = "case", domain, name = paste0(name, ", ", citation),
    badges = "<span class=\"status status-case\">Supreme Court</span>",
    href = paste0("../cases/", id, ".html"),
    text = plain_wiki(first_sentence(holding), statutes)
  )
)

for (e in era_breaks$era) {
  s <- items |> dplyr::filter(era == e) |> dplyr::arrange(year, kind != "statute", name)
  if (!nrow(s)) next
  cat("## ", e, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("<div class=\"timeline\">\n")
  cat(paste0(
    "<div class=\"tl-item domain-", s$domain, dplyr::if_else(s$kind == "case", " tl-case", ""), "\"",
    dplyr::if_else(s$kind == "statute", paste0(" data-statute=\"", s$id, "\""), ""), ">",
    "<div class=\"tl-year\">", s$year, "</div>",
    "<div class=\"tl-body\"><a href=\"", s$href, "\"><strong>", s$name, "</strong></a> ", s$badges,
    "<div class=\"tl-text\">", s$text, "</div></div></div>"
  ), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n</div>\n\n")
}
```
